papers.title: Microstructure and properties of Ti-6Al-4V/Ni-Ti heterogeneous structure with Cu Ni interlayer fabricated by wire-arc directed energy deposition
papers.first_author_affiliation: School of Materials Science and Engineering, Tianjin University of Technology, Tianjin 300384, China

corresponding_authors.name: Yinbao Tian
corresponding_authors.affiliation: School of Materials Science and Engineering, Tianjin University of Technology, Tianjin 300384, China

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及Ti-6Al-4V，但主要研究的是Ti-6Al-4V/Ni-Ti异质结构及其Cu-Ni中间层，而非单独的Ti-6Al-4V增材制造的力学与疲劳性能。
llm.why_not_core: The paper focuses on a heterogeneous Ti-6Al-4V/Ni-Ti structure with a Cu-Ni interlayer, not on the mechanical or fatigue performance of pure additively manufactured Ti-6Al-4V as required by Layer 1.

summary_zh.motivation: 制备Ti-6Al-4V/Ni-Ti异质结构并研究其界面和性能。
summary_zh.method: 采用电弧增材制造（WA-DED）沉积Cu-Ni中间层连接Ti-6Al-4V和Ni-Ti。
summary_zh.result: 实现了良好的界面结合，力学性能优于单一材料。
summary_zh.validation: 通过显微组织和力学测试验证界面质量和强化机制。

summary_en.motivation: To fabricate a Ti-6Al-4V/Ni-Ti heterogeneous structure using a Cu-Ni interlayer via wire-arc directed energy deposition and investigate its interfacial microstructure and mechanical properties.
summary_en.method: Wire-arc directed energy deposition (WA-DED) was employed to deposit a Cu-Ni interlayer between Ti-6Al-4V and Ni-Ti shape memory alloy.
summary_en.result: A sound metallurgical bond was achieved, and the heterogeneous structure exhibited enhanced mechanical properties compared to the individual constituents.
summary_en.validation: Microstructural characterization and mechanical testing were conducted to validate the interfacial integrity and strengthening mechanisms.
